notes: C's exact usage line is emitted when the connection argument is absent.
atoi-zero/non-numeric input, including "all", is usage rather than a bulk disconnect.
Unknown numeric descriptors emit the exact no-such-connection line.
The command is reachable at exactly LVL_IMMORT+1 (32), not only at LVL_GOD.
The actor cannot close a connection whose logged-in character is equal or higher level.
The lower-level peer is marked for close and the actor receives the exact numbered confirmation.
